summary: Owner-scoped, immutable class-demo attempts with strict field validation. Eight local emulator test methods passed. Rules do not prove that a client-computed score was earned.

findings.issue: Any authenticated owner can fabricate an integer score within the allowed range.
findings.recommendation: Use trusted server-side scoring for a competitive or graded system that must resist modified clients.

findings.issue: The supplied candidate required an existing timestamp to equal the current read time.
findings.recommendation: Implemented stored timestamp type checks and a creation-only request.time comparison; later reads passed the emulator test.

findings.issue: An owner must be able to check a missing document before creating it in a transaction.
findings.recommendation: Implemented owner-only get permission for nonexistent attempt paths; missing-document reads passed the emulator test.

checks.update_bypass: Updates and deletes denied; emulator test passed.
checks.authority_source: UID comes from request.auth and must match the document path; isolation tests passed.
checks.field_limits: Exactly six fields with fixed or bounded values; schema tests passed.
checks.type_safety: Integers, variant string, and timestamp validated; malformed-type tests passed.
checks.field_and_identity_security: Both ownership and shape checked; cross-user and extra-field tests passed.

deployment_status: Not deployed; Firebase project selection is pending.
